safety_verdicts.content: The headache improves when the patient is lying down.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Gold states the headache improves when lying down; Generated notes the patient is generally lying down but does not state improvement with lying down.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Postural improvement (better when lying down) can materially shift the differential (e.g., CSF leak/intracranial hypotension vs migraine) and may change advice on escalation and workup. Omitting it risks delayed recognition of a potentially non-benign secondary headache cause.
